messages:
carmen: FYI seeing a cluster of fnhook validation rejects from eu-west over the last 30m. many look like union/nullable fields where the model returns an empty string. our validator treats "" as a hard reject which then routes to degen and increments reject-metering. this is noisy for customers and alerting. example below.

	drew: example from logs:```json
{
  "request_id": "req_9ab",
  "operation": "classify",
  "output": ""  // schema says output: Result | null
}```

	maria: product question  if we coerce empty-string->null, do we still display a "validation reject" in the console? customers see rejects but the app returned something so they're confused.

	jon: on-call impact: we currently page when reject_rate > 0.5% / 5m. a flurry of these coercible cases causes noise. we should differentiate soft vs hard rejects in metrics so SRE can ignore soft ones for paging.

	kevin: telemetry gap: our event currently is `fncall.reject` with reason enums. propose adding `fncall.validation_mode` (strict|soft), `fncall.validation_detail` (nullable-empty-string, numeric-coercion, bad-json), and `billing_impact` (true|false). low-card tags + a `sampled_payload=true` when we persist the raw output.

	carmen: proposed plan: implement a `soft_validation` mode for fnhooks that allows a small curated set of coercions (empty-string->null for unions, small numeric strings -> number). soft-validated responses should NOT trigger degen routing; instead we keep the original model route and flag the run with `validation=soft` and a warning in the response envelope. rollout behind FF 5%->25%->100%.

	maria: console UX: add a "Validation" column on the function runs table (ok | soft-validated | hard-rejected) and in the run details show original raw output + coerced result + rule applied (redacted). route-level toggle please, not org-wide. also a banner during canary: "Soft validation enabled for subset of requests."

	jon: ops caveat: soft-validate must only apply when output is syntactically parseable. if the model returns invalid JSON or times out, still route to degen and count as hard reject. also keep fast fallback for timeouts.

	kevin: metrics to emit: `fncall.validation_mode`, `fncall.validation_detail`, `fncall.route_final`, and numeric `fncall.reject_cost_tokens`. dashboard tile: `soft_validated_rate` and `billing_impact_token_sum`. alert: if hard_rejects > 0.5% OR soft_validated_rate rises > 10% in 10m then escalate.

	carmen: I'll add FF `fnhook.soft_validation_v1`, toggle `routing.policy.degen_on_hard_reject_only`, validator rule list, and telemetry fields. rollout eu-west canary.

	maria: UX will add the column + per-route toggle + run detail diff view. agree on banner.

	jon: I'll update runbooks + SLO exemptions so soft-validates don't page.

	kevin: will wire up the metrics and add the dashboard panel. sampling rule for long payloads 1/50.

	carmen: deploy request: @deploy-bot can you schedule eu-west canary for tomorrow 09:30 UTC, FF at 5%?

	deploy-bot: scheduled deploy to eu-west Canary at 2026-03-23T09:30:00Z. Feature flag `fnhook.soft_validation_v1` = enabled for 5% traffic. Sampling rule added: 1/50 long-form telemetry. :white_check_mark:

	kevin: added items to observability board. i'll paste dashboard link when live.

	carmen: action items recap: (1) validator + route tweak (carmen/drew), (2) telemetry + metrics + dashboards (kevin), (3) console UI + banner + per-route toggle (maria), (4) runbook + SLO changes (jon). i'll open PRs and link here. thanks! :sparkles:
